description: This source file defines an Android Activity (ContentBrowserNavActivity) demonstrating immersive UI with system UI flags and includes a nested Content class for content display with immersive modes. It also handles UI toggling, tab management, and sharing actions.

classes.name: ContentBrowserNavActivity
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating immersive UI and tab navigation, handles menu actions and search.

classes.name: Content
classes.description: A custom ScrollView that manages immersive system UI flags and toggles visibility based on user interaction.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and configures tabs.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates menu, sets up search view and share action provider.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for toggling tabs and UI layout.

methods.name: onQueryTextChange
methods.description: Handles live search text changes (stub implementation).

methods.name: onQueryTextSubmit
methods.description: Handles search submission, shows a toast with the query.
